content.title: Saddi Washington (Michigan) and DeAndre Haynes (Maryland) | Assistant Basketball Coaches
content.text: Powered by Saddi Washington (Michigan) & DeAndre Haynes (Maryland) | Assistant Basketball Coaches Guest Saddi Washington, Michigan; DeAndre Haynes, Maryland 33:13 min listen Assistant Men’s Basketball Coaches Saddi Washington of Michigan and DeAndre Haynes of Maryland visit @1QLeadership on leadership during the pandemic. The two cover learning from their head coaches on how to manage sudden change as a leader. Washington talks on being on the floor to play in the Big Ten tournament when the season was cancelled. He also discusses working with first-time head coach Howard. Haynes touches on being Big Ten champions and leading Student-Athletes through the loss of the season.
